main_body: steel column with capital, shaft, and base
top_band: light grey top surface of capital at rows 9-11, followed by a lighter front-edge highlight at row 12
evidence: The column capital shows a clear 3-row horizontal top plane (rows 9-11) in mid-light grey, a bright front edge at row 12, riveted front rim at row 13, and deep eave shadow at rows 14-16 above the vertical fluted shaft (rows 17-40) and base (rows 41-47).
